mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth and industrial production indicate weakening economic activity, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns when the correlation between the series drops below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index levels above 210 indicate persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 210.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units signal robust consumer demand for dwellings, indicating expanding economic activity and positive corporate earnings growth that generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates weakening manufacturing output, signaling economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth combined with elevated interest rates signals an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 138000 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0% fails to predict negative returns when the correlation between PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS drops below 0.7.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment below 350,000 million dollars indicates housing market contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending which leads to negative S&P 500 returns during housing market downturns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during the housing market downturn regime as defined by RSAFS falling below 350,000.
